name: DropGenius
summary: Generates a Shopify dropshipping store — products, branding and copy — as a starting template, not a finished business. Public buyer reviews cluster on one complaint: charges continuing after cancellation, with no route to a refund.
best_for: absolute beginners who want a pre-built Shopify dropshipping store scaffold in minutes and understand it's a starting point, not a business
skip_if: you are uncomfortable with the documented billing complaints — or you expect an AI-generated store to sell by itself
honest_knock: We have to be blunt here: the dominant theme in DropGenius’s public buyer reviews is unauthorised charges continuing after cancellation with no route to a refund, and some reviewers report never reaching a dashboard to cancel at all, with support emails bouncing back undeliverable. An AI-generated store in 30 seconds is also just a starting template — the product selection, marketing and margins remain entirely your problem. If you proceed: pay attention to cancellation mechanics from day one, screenshot everything, and treat the Renewal Radar as mandatory equipment.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Pro · per month billed annually at $288 -- cheaper than the $39 monthly Starter, which is not offered annually at all
pricing.notes: Re-verified 19 September 2026 on their own pricing page, unchanged since August. Monthly: Starter $39, Pro $59, Empire $99, Unicorn $299, each with a 14-day free trial. Switch to annual billing and Starter disappears from the table; the rest become Pro $24/mo (billed annually at $288), Empire $57/mo ($684) and Unicorn $79/mo ($948). The meter is catalogue size: Starter 25 unique products, Pro 250 unique plus 25 premium, Empire 10,000 and 10,000, Unicorn 25,000 and 25,000. The FAQ on their own homepage, re-read the same day, still quotes an older $39.99-$299.99 range plus a $1.99 one-time store-creation fee, so the marketing copy and the pricing table continue to disagree. Nothing anywhere on the pricing page mentions the Shopify subscription the generated store runs on.
